headline: Airbnb limits chores hosts can demand of guests
pages: New Airbnb rules on what hosts can ask guests to do have taken effect. Hosts should not normally ask guests to wash up, strip beds, take out rubbish or avoid using utilities, though they can appeal to Airbnb if they have a compelling reason. Hosts can now choose from seven standard house rules, such as how many people may stay overnight and whether pets or smoking are allowed, and then add extra rules. If an extra rule is not approved and the host keeps it, Airbnb will flag it on the listing with a message such as includes cleaning tasks. Airbnb says chores make customers hesitate to book and that clearer rules should bring more bookings. Some guests found long rule lists tiring.
Some hosts say they may pass higher cleaning costs on to guests. Why it matters: the change could affect prices and what guests are expected to do at rental properties. Source: BBC.
